systemic_note: Three systemic causes recur. (1) 26.x tag reads: the port reads six tag names 1.21.10 never had (speleothems, cauldron_can_remove_dye, potion tags, the two 26.x snow-layer names, sculk_growth_inhibitors) — B11-G04, B11-G05, B11-G14, B11-G16. (2) 26.x component reads: DataComponents has no cooking_fuel/brewing_fuel/compostable/villager_food/mob_visibility in 1.21.10 — B11-G07 (and the B4-G01 furnace consequence). (3) Post-5006 save forms: the palette reader accepts only id/properties while 1.21.10 writes Name/Properties — B11-G10, inherited from the 1.21.11 template. Against that, the class table is in markedly better shape than 26.1.2's: dual names for every 1.21.10 rename, all six dead mappings inert (two paired with live twins, four 26.x-only blocks with no blocks to fire on), and 17 of the 31 1.21.7 re-checks FIXED in this tree.
